nodes.label: Audio Feature-SyncD/SyncC Correlation Heatmap
nodes.description: Spearman correlation heatmap (n=447) between 20 audio features and SyncD/SyncC metrics. Key findings: LUFS correlates strongly with both SyncD (0.92) and SyncC (0.92); energy_env_smoothness also highly correlated (0.93); SyncD and SyncC are negatively correlated (-0.68).

metadata.finding: Loudness (LUFS) and energy envelope smoothness are strongest predictors of lip-sync quality; SyncD and SyncC measure different aspects of synchronization

hyperedges.label: Audio Feature Analysis for Lip-Sync Prediction
hyperedges.description: Multi-figure exploratory analysis of 15+ audio features and their relationship to lip-sync metrics. Features compared between natural and TTS speech; correlations, PCA, RF importance, and scatter plots reveal MFCC variability and loudness as key predictors.
